checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=33 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=1.7 tightness=0.73 base_volume_vs_leg=0.69 base_volume_vs_avg=0.97
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 33 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; the base gave back 1.7 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close -4.3% vs its 20-SMA, -8.4% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 1 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The chart shows CMI in a persistent multi-month downtrend with all three moving averages sloping sharply lower and price making lower lows throughout the base region — the shaded consolidation box sits inside a declining channel, not a tight orderly pause after an upleg. Three independent measured FAILs (C, RE, VOL) compound the visual problem: the base is 33 sessions with a giveback of 1.7x the leg, the burst bar is less than half the range of the prior five bars, and volume falls well short of the 1.5x average required for a base this long. The signal bar itself is a red close on a negative day (-0.28% close-to-close), consistent with a downtrend continuation rather than a momentum burst.
claude.key_risk: Price is in a confirmed downtrend with declining moving averages and heavy overhead supply from months of prior trading above the signal level; any bounce is likely to be sold into.
claude.entry_note: Skip at the open regardless — the setup has three hard FAILs and the chart shows a declining base inside a downtrend, not a consolidation worth entering.
